items.title: Phil Woods interviewed by Monk Rowe, Delaware Water Gap, PA, November 8, 1999
items.q: My dentist actually, Dr. Phil Terman, is a very fine clarinetist, was the guy who sponsored it, was the bread man, he paid for it.

ctx.x: And you’ve got a jazz tutor program out.

Yeah. For CD ROM. Not moving as well as we’d like it, but I haven’t seen anybody doing one any better. It’s a great product. I’d recommend it to kids. It’s under a hundred bucks and it’s got my whole method in there, because I no longer teach. I taught pretty near 50 years. My dentist actually, Dr. Phil Terman, is a very fine clarinetist, was the guy who sponsored it, was the bread man, he paid for it. He’s quite a computer guy and his son is a great programmer. So that’s why we did the CD ROM. But it’s not for…
Any future projects coming up that you’d like to mention?
